remarks: Welcome to this well maintained 2-bedroom + loft townhouse nestled in Stamford's desirable West Side neighborhood. Freshly painted throughout, this move-in ready home offers flexible living with a versatile loft perfect for a home office, playroom, or guest space.  Enjoy the convenience of in-unit washer/dryer and a 2-car attached garage. With 1.5 baths, private balcony and thoughtfully laid-out living spaces, this home checks every box for comfortable everyday living. Ideally located just minutes from Stamford Hospital, vibrant Downtown Stamford, parks, restaurants, and shopping, this home offers exceptional convenience. Commuters will appreciate the easy access to both I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. With everything you need just moments away, this is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and a prime Stamford location. Don't miss your chance to make this home your own! Excellent credit required.
